entries.title: Fixed Double Cradle and Tank Over Engine Motorcycle
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete empty motorcycle-style static exterior. Two broad annular tires with open rims, complete spokes, hubs and fixed transverse axles carry a new twin-fork and rear-swing-arm organization. Two continuous closed lower cradle loops surround an independent round crankcase, integral-rib cylinder and complete head. A full sculpted longitudinal tank occupies the upper frame, while two whole rear rails support a separate long stepped saddle over the rear wheel. Full fixed suspension-strut appearances, fork crowns, raised handlebar/grips, blank round headlamp, two genuinely thick raised mudguard arches and a complete bent side exhaust with long low muffler finish the whole vehicle. A deployed two-foot stand accompanies the actual finite tire tread facets. This is not the existing thin diamond-frame pedal bicycle with a motor pasted on: no old frame, pedal crank, chainring or mesh is reused. It is not the existing step-through scooter with different wheels: there is no low foot deck, leg shield, enclosing rear seat body or open step-through bay. Every visible coordinate is newly authored to the complete engine-in-cradle/tank/saddle/fork/swing-arm organization. One prop zero scenes, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole horizontal-envelope-centered ground datum. Simplified invented fixed illustrative exterior only: no rider, internal engine, fuel path, exhaust fluid, real brakes, suspension spring, drivetrain, steering, wheel rotation, speed, balance, rider fit, load, roadworthiness, manufacture or operating safety is made or verified. Rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Double Open End Cap and Spine Sampling Cylinder
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete empty water-sampling-cylinder-inspired static exterior. A single thick long tube has genuine top and bottom open ports. Each end has a complete separate solid cap fixed vertically out beside the port on a full side pivot, with its own continuous curved retaining cord attached to a full external longitudinal spine. Two entire outer clamp bands and short rear bridges attach tube to spine, with a true open rear handgrip and a small integrated display foot. Unlike the old closed paired diving cylinders there are no domed bottle bottoms, paired tanks or top valves; unlike the footed laboratory cylinder there is no inner floor, pour lip or scale. Every visible part newly authored. One model zero scenes. Static illustrative empty exhibit only, not a usable Niskin bottle or working hinge/closure: no water collection, depth, pressure, sealing, fluid volume, deployment, scientific accuracy, manufacture, handling or safety claim. Rig animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Twin Gauge Manifold and Whole Hose Set
entries.description: One newly authored complete twin-gauge manifold-style tool set in a fixed flat resting presentation. A whole short horizontal valve-body exterior carries two separate upper round gauge cases with actual recessed blank opaque faces, two end knobs, three lower whole hose sockets and one continuous open hanging hook. Three entire flexible-hose-shaped solids remain connected to the three lower sockets and terminate in complete blunt coupling exteriors. All belong to one complete set, not three separately counted hoses or two independently counted gauges. Unlike the old cuff/bulb instrument there is no cuff or squeeze bulb and the two gauges are directly rooted in a common two-knob manifold bar; unlike a receiver compressor there is no tank, trolley, belt or drive. All visible vertices newly authored, no old gauge or hose extracted. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, complete horizontally centred ground datum on the backs and hose undersides, one model zero scenes. Empty static artistic maintenance-tool exterior only: no readable scale, measurement, pressure, refrigerant, flow path, valve action, connection compatibility, service procedure, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Pier Floor and Wall Flue Room Cutaway
entries.description: One newly authored complete static hypocaust-inspired room section. A continuous low foundation supports a grid of full short masonry piers under one thick L-section retained room floor. The deliberately removed front-right floor area exposes the real underfloor chamber and column-supported floor datum. A separate whole low arched fire corridor passes through a genuine opening in the lower front wall into that chamber. One integral rear wall contains three full hollow vertical channels with actual low front inlets below the floor and open upper ends; the central channel also has an explicit above-floor inspection section. A retained tall side wall and short lower side return define the room boundary. Unlike an open stilt granary, the void is enclosed below an occupied floor with separate side fire entry and wall risers; unlike the rising pottery kiln, the fire chamber is below a pier-supported upper room rather than within a rising loading vault. All visible geometry newly authored, no existing kiln, granary or room mesh imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, full ground foundation and horizontally centred bounds. One architectural module zero scenes. Empty historical-style artistic cutaway only, not a reconstruction or building proposal. No fire, smoke, fuel, hot gases, heating performance, airflow, flue sizing, occupancy, structural load, fire resistance, manufacture, construction or engineering safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction made or verified.
